responsibility: This generator script produces mova.md, the H8SX-only machine-description fragment for patterns implementable with the mova indexed-address arithmetic instruction. It systematically emits RTL patterns for zero-extended indices, scaled adds, shifts, multiplies, masking forms, and immediate-base address computations across QI/HI/SI combinations, serving as code-generation infrastructure that derives a large family of canonical mova recognizers rather than hand-maintained backend logic.
